name: Misono Chiharu
source:
Kazunori's childhood friend and the manager of the coffee shop Espoir. She was Kazunori's first love, but she married another man. However, her husband eloped with a waitress, so she is currently "single". 

She is cheerful, energetic, kind, patient, and compassionate. On the other hand, she is lonely, jealous, and very jealous.

Perhaps because her husband ran off with another woman, she is in a great deal of depression.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=734946]Getchu[/url]]
